title: Full GTA 6 soundtrack album tracklist leaks days before the game's release
summary: Billboard and Rolling Stone say the 34-song list, featuring Travis Scott, Cardi B and Dua Lipa, is accurate.
body:
The full tracklist for GTA VI: The Album, the soundtrack album for the video game Grand Theft Auto VI, leaked on social media on Saturday 14 November.

The list has 34 songs. Billboard and Rolling Stone both say their sources have confirmed it is accurate. Rockstar Games has not officially released it.

Who is on it

Artists on the album include Travis Scott, Cardi B and Dua Lipa. Scott's track, "RHYNO", was produced by Guy-Manuel de Homem-Christo, formerly of Daft Punk.

The game is due out on Thursday 19 November.

Sources: Billboard, Rolling Stone, PC Gamer.
author: ICONDAILY
